entries.body: Docs: HB-03 lodging memo: Zurich/Geneva/Oslo 270 (§2), not contractors (§3); base HB-22. HB-09 home-office memo: medical plan 750, carve-out part-time<20h; base HB-11 v3 eff 2026-03-01 500 (§2) +150 remote 4+ days (§3), supersedes HB-32 (check HB-32 for 2026-02-15). HB-13 lodging superseded 210. Other relevant: meals 17,27,33; training 18,23,26; mobile 20,25,31,37; car 29,38,39. Today=2026-10-13.

== 32 
§1 Scope
§2 Standard home-office equipment allowance
  Employees may claim a one-off home-office equipment allowance of 400 EUR.
§3 Additions
  For employees who work remotely four or more days a week, 150 EUR was added to the standard home-office equipment allowance.
§4 Version status
== 22 
§1 Scope
§2 Standard nightly lodging limit
  The nightly lodging limit for business travel is 150 EUR per night, including taxes and city fees.
§3 Additions
  For a stay that includes a Saturday night, 25 EUR per night is added to the standard nightly lodging limit.
§4 Approval and receipts
§5 Exceptions
== 17 
§1 Scope
§2 Standard daily meal allowance
  The daily meal allowance during business travel was 47 EUR per day.
§3 Additions
  For a day with an approved client dinner, 30 EUR per day was added to the standard daily meal allowance.
§4 Version status
== 27 
§1 Scope
§2 Standard daily meal allowance
  The daily meal allowance during business travel is 54 EUR per day.
§3 Additions
  For a day with an approved client dinner, 30 EUR per day is added to the standard daily meal allowance.
§4 Approval and receipts
§5 Exceptions
== 33 
§1 Purpose
§2 Exception for client-site days in London or Paris
  For client-site days in London or Paris, the daily meal allowance is 84 EUR per day instead of the standard amount.
§3 Carve-out
  The exception above does not apply to interns; they follow the standard daily meal allowance in HB-27 §2.
§4 Review
== 18 
§1 Scope
§2 Standard annual training budget
  Each employee has an annual training budget of 1150 EUR per calendar year.
§3 Additions
  For employees who hold a team-lead role, 550 EUR per year is added to the standard annual training budget.
§4 Approval and receipts
§5 Exceptions
== 23 
§1 Scope
§2 Standard annual training budget
  Each employee has an annual training budget of 1450 EUR per calendar year.
§3 Additions
  For employees who hold a team-lead role, 550 EUR per year was added to the standard annual training budget.
§4 Version status
== 26 
§1 Purpose
§2 Exception for employees in the security team
  For employees in the security team, the annual training budget is 2500 EUR per year instead of the standard amount.
§3 Carve-out
  The exception above does not apply to employees still in their probation period; they follow the standard annual training budget in HB-18 §2.
§4 Review
== 31 
§1 Scope
§2 Standard monthly mobile allowance
  Employees who use a private phone for work receive a mobile allowance of 36 EUR per month.
§3 Additions
  For employees on international rotation, 16 EUR per month was added to the standard monthly mobile allowance.
§4 Version status
== 37 
§1 Scope
§2 Standard monthly mobile allowance
  Employees who use a private phone for work receive a mobile allowance of 40 EUR per month.
§3 Additions
  For employees on international rotation, 16 EUR per month is added to the standard monthly mobile allowance.
§4 Approval and receipts
§5 Exceptions
== 25 
§1 Purpose
§2 Exception for field engineers
  For field engineers, the monthly mobile allowance is 66 EUR per month instead of the standard amount.
§3 Carve-out
  The exception above does not apply to field engineers on a company-paid phone contract; they follow the standard monthly mobile allowance in HB-37 §2.
§4 Review
== 29 
§1 Scope
§2 Standard mileage rate
  Business kilometres driven with a private car are reimbursed at 34 cents per km.
§3 Additions
  For trips towing a trailer, 4 cents per km is added to the standard mileage rate.
§4 Approval and receipts
§5 Exceptions
== 38 
§1 Scope
§2 Standard mileage rate
  Business kilometres driven with a private car are reimbursed at 36 cents per km.
§3 Additions
  For trips towing a trailer, 4 cents per km was added to the standard mileage rate.
§4 Version status
== 39 
§1 Purpose
§2 Exception for electric vehicles
  For electric vehicles, the mileage rate is 46 cents per km instead of the standard amount.
§3 Carve-out
  The exception above does not apply to electric rental cars; they follow the standard mileage rate in HB-29 §2.
§4 Review
